description: This file defines an abstract class for handling MQTT subscriptions within a connectivity service. It manages source-actor pairs, prepares subscription messages, and handles subscribe operations, including tracking of MQTT sources, QoS settings, and actor communication.

classes.name: AbstractMqttSubscriptionHandler
classes.description: An abstract class managing MQTT subscription logic, including source actor mappings, subscription preparation, and subscribing to MQTT sources.

classes.name: AbstractMqttSubscriptionHandler.MqttConsumer
classes.description: A static inner class pairing a Source with its associated ActorRef representing a consumer actor.

classes.name: AbstractMqttSubscriptionHandler.SubscribeAction
classes.description: A functional interface abstracting the subscribe operation for MQTT clients, parameterized by message types.

methods.name: toMqttSubscribe
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a Source into an MQTT subscribe message.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a stream of current source/actor pairs wrapped as MqttConsumer objects.

methods.name: handleMqttConsumer
methods.description: Adds a new source and its associated consumer actor to internal mappings.

methods.name: allConsumersReady
methods.description: Checks if all sources have an associated consumer actor, indicating readiness.

methods.name: clearConsumerActors
methods.description: Removes all registered consumer actors, applying a given callback on each removal.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Performs the subscription process for all sources, returning a Future list of SUBACK messages.

methods.name: asAddressQoSPair
methods.description: Creates a pair of address string and QoS level based on the source configuration.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Handles the actual subscription request for a source, using the provided subscribe action and actor.

methods.name: prepareSubscriptions
methods.description: Initializes the map of sources to their subscription messages.
